answer:
The largest aircraft carrier in the world, the **USS Gerald R. Ford (CVN-78)**, is named after **Gerald Ford**, who was the **38th President of the United States** (serving from 1974 to 1977). 

Gerald Ford was a Navy veteran who served on the light aircraft carrier USS Monterey (CVA-26) during World War II as an aviation cadet and later as a reserve officer. The Ford-class carriers are designed to be the most advanced and capable aircraft carriers ever built by the United States Navy.
